title: Tech Saturn Tsuushin Vol. 5: Summer 1996
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ サターン通信 Ｖｏｌ．５
overview: The CD-ROM packaged with the Summer 1996 issue (Vol. 5) of ASCII's TECH Saturn Tsuushin magazine. Along with demo versions of Saturn games, it includes the magazine's Tech Broadcasting section of original video features, with content ranging from AM2 interviews to offbeat editorial segments.
